mcqs.question:
With reference to India's medicinal and aromatic plant wealth, consider the following statements:
1. India is one of the 17 mega-biodiverse countries.
2. India accounts for approximately 8% of global biodiversity.
3. Around 18,000 plant species in India are medicinal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: India is one of the 17 mega-biodiverse countries. India has approximately 7% of global biodiversity and around 15,000 medicinal plant species, not 8% and 18,000 respectively.

mcqs.keyword: Medicinal plant documentation and in-situ conservation
mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding medicinal plants and their conservation in India.

List-I
(a) Plant species documented by BSI
(b) Traditional medicinal claims documented by BSI
(c) Medicinal Plants Conservation Areas
(d) Type of conservation represented by MPCAs

List-II
(i) In-situ conservation
(ii) 9,500+
(iii) 115
(iv) 5,250

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iv, b-ii, c-iii and d-i: BSI documented 5,250 species and more than 9,500 traditional claims, while in-situ conservation comprises 115 Medicinal Plants Conservation Areas. The other codes interchange these figures or wrongly associate MPCAs with another conservation category.
